One Base / Three Directions

An elevation explored
through three choices.

The base, openings and overall massing stay the same while colour, privacy and railing detail are tested as three directions. Tap the numbered points on each render. The process behind the first direction is shown at the end.

Tap a numbered point

Design process · Option 01

From base to sandal + ochre

The wall is a large plain vertical surface. Grooves cut into it break it into panels, and the shadow lines make it read as an interesting facade. The MS railing carries the same fine detail down to the balconies.

01

Base

Base elevation. Massing and openings stay unchanged.

02

Sandal applied

A dull sandal textured finish on the wall planes.

03

Ochre bands

Horizontal ochre bands on the balcony slabs and under the windows.

04

MS railing

A slim black MS railing replaces the glass balustrade.

05

External grooves

Grooves break the plain vertical wall into panels, and the shadow lines give it depth.

06

Final render

All layers together, with planters and wall lights.
